rejected: poly.pizza 'CRT Monitor' by Jarlan Perez (8jVB0zIXKCv) and the Google Poly CRT/TV models (2D221SHzAER, eCQBPXzmq1C): page JSON reports Licence 'CC-BY 3.0' - attribution required, skipped.

Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit full pack from quaternius.com: CC0, but the download is a Google Drive folder (not curl-able); the useful props were instead taken as individually verified GLBs from poly.pizza (and another lane fetched the whole bundle as quaternius-cyberpunk-game-kit).

Kenney City Kit (Industrial): CC0 and downloaded, but it is building-scale exteriors (factories, chimneys, water tower, shipping containers) with little interior value; deleted to stay under the size budget.
Kenney Furniture Kit and Kenney City Kit (Commercial): CC0 but already fetched by another lane (present in src/); not duplicated.
poly.pizza 'Fan' by kazuma (QdOxYDGjhN, 5954 tris) and 'Skateboard' by cg_world (Bt1Iql32Ox, 6422 tris): CC0 but too dense for the flat-shaded target; lower-poly equivalents used instead.

poly.pizza fire-extinguisher, mask (Guy Fawkes/anonymous), bicycle, server-rack and neon-sign searches with the CC0 filter returned no matching models (only weapons, hydrants, gas cans, a motorcycle, coat racks, cyberpunk signs) - recorded as gaps rather than downloading off-target items.
Kenney Survival Kit / Holiday Kit / Graveyard Kit / Space Kit: CC0 but off-theme (camping, festive, spooky, sci-fi), not downloaded.
